reads.question: Using only the exemption systems identified as available in the current solved reasoning, jointly identify every current asset-provision pair whose statutory property category actually covers that asset. Return parallel flat arrays in statute source order. Citations must be exact literal citation strings without jurisdiction-heading prefixes. Caps must be numeric, must reflect any applicable joint-debtor combination rule, and must be -1 only for an uncapped exemption.
